videos.titleEn: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.originalTitle: How are microchips made? Episode 6 | ASML Nanoland
videos.author: ASML
videos.captionNote: 字幕與自動翻譯依原平台提供，未保證完整繁體中文字幕。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「異質接面：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Heterojunction: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「場板：建立模型」列為查證任務：場形塑可能同時增加寄生電容；增加寄生電容可能增加切換能量。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Field plates: construct and analyze: Field shaping may also increase capacitance; Added capacitance can increase switching energy.

courses.overview: 從「氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體」延伸比較碳化矽 MOSFET 製程、砷化鎵射頻元件製作：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistors by comparing Silicon-carbide MOSFET processing and Gallium-arsenide RF-device fabrication: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SiC 與 GaN 功率元件都需處理導通損失、開關損失、熱與可靠度，系統評估必須同一工作條件。
related.transferEn: SiC and GaN power devices both require conduction, switching, thermal and reliability evaluation under matched system conditions.
related.difference: SiC MOSFET 依 MOS 通道與體二極體；GaN HEMT 依異質接面載子氣。反向導通與閘極應力不能套同一元件模型。
related.differenceEn: SiC MOSFETs use a MOS channel and body diode; GaN HEMTs use a heterojunction carrier gas. Reverse conduction and gate stress need different models.
practice: 畫兩者通道與反向電流路徑。
在相同假設工作點比較損失項。
分開材料優勢與封裝／驅動造成的差異。
practiceEn: Draw each channel and reverse-current path.
Compare loss terms at the same hypothetical operating point.
Separate material advantages from package and drive differences.
related.title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate campus reference, reusing reviewed V7 coordinates; a metrology/standards connection, not a claim that all course devices are fabricated here.

related.why: SiC 與 GaN 功率元件都需處理導通損失、開關損失、熱與可靠度，系統評估必須同一工作條件。
related.whyEn: SiC and GaN power devices both require conduction, switching, thermal and reliability evaluation under matched system conditions.

related.transfer: GaN HEMT 與 GaAs RF 元件都依賴異質結構、低寄生接觸及高頻量測，需同時看增益與效率。
related.transferEn: GaN HEMTs and GaAs RF devices use heterostructures, low-parasitic contacts and RF characterization, balancing gain and efficiency.
related.difference: GaAs 可採 HBT 或 pHEMT，不能把所有 GaAs 都當 HEMT；材料、載子注入及熱設計與 GaN 並不等同。
related.differenceEn: GaAs may use HBT or pHEMT architectures; not every GaAs device is a HEMT. Materials, injection and thermal design differ from GaN.
practice: 分別畫 HBT 與 HEMT 的載子控制方式。
拆分接觸、閘極及互連寄生。
對齊頻率、偏壓與功率條件後再比較效率。
practiceEn: Draw carrier control in an HBT and a HEMT.
Separate contact, gate and interconnect parasitics.
Match frequency, bias and power before comparing efficiency.
related.title: 砷化鎵射頻元件製作

courses.summary: 本課以「imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從異質接面、緩衝層到整合驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Heterojunction and Buffer layer to Integration verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
